instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components (buttons, sliders, mode chips, routing cells, remote pads, pin digits) have clear `data-testid` attributes following kebab-case.
The UI must feel like a native mobile or tablet Control4 app — responsive, tactile, high density, smooth transitions, instant feed feedback.
Implement real-time state management using React hooks/context so matrix routing updates reflect live in room tiles, TV statuses, and audio zone cards.
Provide a simulated WebSocket / Driver status drawer showing JTECH-MXT40 matrix serial commands, WS66i RS232 protocols, UniFi RTSP stream, and Ecobee API payload for developer clarity.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use transparent background on header, overlays, or dropdowns without blur and dark tint.
Ensure APCA WCAG high contrast ratios for text on dark backgrounds.
Layered dark card styles with 1px subtle borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)).
Micro-animations on hover and active states (framer-motion or CSS transitions).
